title: Sales Pipeline Review
transcripts: David
Let's get started. This month's pipeline is looking strong across all regions.
Jessica
Agreed. We've got three major deals slated to close before quarter end.
David
Walk us through the forecast numbers for the West region.
Marcus
West is tracking about 12% ahead of target, mostly driven by the Atlas renewal.
Priya
On the customer side, churn risk is down. Support tickets from our top accounts are trending well.
David
Good. Let's follow up individually on the three big deals and reconvene next week.

title: Q4 Engineering Roadmap
description: Quarterly planning and team capacity review
transcripts: Aisha
Welcome everyone. Today we're finalizing the Q4 roadmap and checking capacity.
Tom
The platform team has bandwidth for two of the three proposed migrations.
Elena
I'd prioritize the auth service migration — it's blocking the mobile team.
Raj
Mobile agrees. We can't ship offline mode until that's done.
Tom
Understood, we'll move it to the top of the sprint board.
Aisha
Let's also lock the API versioning plan before the next release cut.
Elena
I'll draft the versioning doc and share it by Friday.

title: Product Atlas Kickoff
transcripts: Sofia
This is the kickoff for Atlas — our new mapping feature. Let's cover scope first.
Ben
Phase one is read-only maps with live location markers, no editing yet.
Nina
From a design side, I want to keep the map full-bleed on mobile with a bottom sheet for details.
Sofia
Sounds good. What's realistic for a phase one launch date?
Ben
If scope stays fixed, we can target a six-week build.
Nina
I'll have mockups ready for review by end of next week.
